pt: Cientista da computação, dev desde 2019. Comecei resolvendo problema em hospital com Angular e Elasticsearch, mas virei a chave pra IA quando os modelos da OpenAI ainda chamavam GPT-2 e eu tinha que explicar pra todo mundo o que era um "transformer".

Hoje sou co-founder e Head of Product Development na GoodStream — plataforma de document intelligence pra portfolio management, remoto do Brasil no fuso de Nova York. Lidero o time de engenharia (padrões, DDD, CI/CD, code review), alinho com produto, marketing, CEO e suporte — mas continuo escrevendo código todo dia, porque largar não dá.

No caminho até aqui: tech lead na Me4U (SaaS multimodal de IA), co-fundei Jeto e CopyKit (IA pra empresas), passei pela Olympos (faliu) e Scripe (adquirida pela Olympos). Em paralelo, sigo lutando com o mestrado em Ciência da Computação na PUC Minas. Sim, dá pra fazer as duas coisas. Não, não dá pra dormir bem.
en: Computer scientist, dev since 2019. Started shipping software for hospitals with Angular and Elasticsearch, then jumped on the AI train back when OpenAI models were called GPT-2 and I had to explain to everyone what a "transformer" was.

Today I'm a co-founder and Head of Product Development at GoodStream — a document intelligence platform for portfolio management, building from Brazil on New York time. I lead the engineering team (standards, DDD, CI/CD, code review), align with product, marketing, the CEO and support — and I still write code every day, because I just can't quit it.

How I got here: tech lead at Me4U (multimodal AI SaaS), co-founder at Jeto and CopyKit (AI for businesses), passed through Olympos (shut down) and Scripe (acquired by Olympos). On the side, I'm wrestling a master's in Computer Science at PUC Minas. Yes, you can do both. No, you can't sleep well.

note.en: in progress, on my own time

summary.en: Document intelligence platform for portfolio management. I run engineering, multimodal AI and LLMs in production — remote from Brazil on New York time.

pt: Lidero o time de engenharia: cobertura de testes (unit + E2E), pre-commit hooks, lint e padrão de code review.
Montei CI/CD: deploys automáticos, smart gates, environments separados pra preview e produção.
Arquitetura Domain-Driven Design, TypeScript strict, clean code — sem atalho.
DevOps: migrations, monitoring, error tracking, deploy automation.
Stack: monorepo TS, SvelteKit no front, serverless no back (Cloudflare), integração com LLMs.
en: Leading engineering: test coverage (unit + E2E), pre-commit hooks, lint, and code review standards.
Set up CI/CD: automatic deploys, smart gates, separate preview/production environments.
Domain-Driven Design architecture, TypeScript strict, clean code — no shortcuts.
DevOps: migrations, monitoring, error tracking, deploy automation.
Stack: TS monorepo, SvelteKit front-end, serverless back-end (Cloudflare), LLM integration.

role.pt: ML Engineer → Sr Full Stack → Technical Lead
role.en: ML Engineer → Sr Full Stack → Technical Lead

summary.pt: Entrei como ML engineer, virei senior full stack e depois technical lead de um time de 4 devs. SaaS multimodal: LLMs, TTS, STT, image-to-text, text-to-image, modelos próprios e open-source.
summary.en: Joined as ML engineer, then senior full stack, then technical lead of a 4-dev team. Multimodal SaaS: LLMs, TTS, STT, image-to-text, text-to-image, proprietary and open-source models.

pt: Liderei time de 4 devs construindo plataforma SaaS multimodal de ponta.
Integração de LLMs, TTS/STT, image-to-text e text-to-image — proprietários e open-source.
Infra automatizada permitindo o usuário final treinar e deployar seus próprios modelos.
Backend robusto + UI intuitiva — guiei a stack do front até o deploy.
Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Node, pipelines de ML.
en: Led a 4-dev team building a cutting-edge multimodal SaaS.
Integrated LLMs, TTS/STT, image-to-text and text-to-image — proprietary and open-source.
Automated infrastructure letting end users train and deploy their own custom models.
Robust back-end + intuitive UI — guided the stack from front to deploy.
Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Node, ML pipelines.

summary.pt: White-label de IA pra empresa montar o próprio assistente especialista no negócio dela. Atendimento, suporte, conhecimento interno — configurado pelo cliente, não hardcoded. Resolveu problema de várias empresas, rodou um tempo, até a Me4U entrar no radar.
summary.en: White-label AI platform letting companies build their own assistant specialized in their business. Customer support, internal knowledge — configured by the client, not hardcoded. Solved problems for several companies, ran for a while, until Me4U appeared on my radar.

summary.pt: Co-fundei a CopyKit junto com galera que veio da Scripe e da Olympos. Releitura moderna da Scripe — marketing com IA pra empresa. Rodou alguns meses, enxergamos uma oportunidade maior em outras verticais de IA empresarial, e pivotamos pra Jeto.
summary.en: Co-founded CopyKit with people from Scripe and Olympos. A modern take on Scripe — AI marketing for businesses. Ran for a few months, saw a bigger opportunity in other AI verticals, and pivoted to Jeto.

summary.pt: Builder de loja de dropshipping: site personalizado + back-end próprio pra usuário cadastrar produto e vender. Cresceu rápido em 2021–2022, virou referência no segmento, depois faliu. Adquiriu a Scripe no caminho.
summary.en: Dropshipping store builder: custom storefront + proprietary back-end letting users register products and sell. Grew fast in 2021–2022, became a reference in the segment, then shut down. Acquired Scripe along the way.

summary.pt: Primeira startup. Marketing com IA em cima de GPT-2 e GPT-3 — antes do ChatGPT existir. Svelte no front, Node no back, tudo TypeScript com testes. Cresceu rápido, foi adquirida pela Olympos.
summary.en: First startup. AI-powered marketing on GPT-2 and GPT-3 — before ChatGPT was a thing. Svelte front-end, Node back-end, all TypeScript with tests. Grew fast, got acquired by Olympos.

summary.pt: Sistema de prontuário eletrônico pra hospital: editor de texto otimizado, busca em base extensa de termos médicos, classificação automatizada, front adaptável a cada hospital. O day-job que pagou as contas pra eu aprender o resto.
summary.en: Hospital electronic medical record system: optimized text editor, search across a large medical terms database, automated classification, adaptive front-end per hospital. The day job that paid the bills while I learned everything else.
